gloss: to endure; to surpass; to get through

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {凌|しの}いでいませんでした

definitions.gloss: to endure; to weather; to get through
definitions.explanation: To bear hardship or difficult conditions and survive through them.

definitions.gloss: to surpass; to exceed; to outdo
definitions.explanation: To go beyond or exceed something in ability, quality, or quantity.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive verb (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧). Takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ in both senses.

USAGE:
Sense 1 (endure) is about getting through something unpleasant with whatever is at hand — it implies a temporary, makeshift fix rather than a solution:
- ⟦{寒|さむ}さ→寒さ：12336_samusa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{凌|しの}ぐ - to ward off the cold
- ⟦{暑|あつ}さ→暑さ：12973_atsusa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{凌|しの}ぐ - to cope with the heat
- ⟦{飢|う}え→飢え：19826_ue⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{凌|しの}ぐ - to stave off hunger
The object is the hardship itself, not the means of escaping it.

Sense 2 (surpass) is often used with ⟦ほど→ほど：01724_hodo⟧:
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{凌|しの}ぐ⟦ほど→ほど：01724_hodo⟧ - so much as to surpass ~
It carries a note of exceeding something that was expected to be superior — a pupil outdoing a master, a sequel beating the original.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{急場|きゅうば}→急場：noentry⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{凌|しの}ぐ - to get through an emergency
- ⟦{雨風|あめかぜ}→雨風：noentry⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{凌|しの}ぐ - to keep out the wind and rain (of basic shelter)
- ⟦{先輩|せんぱい}→先輩：01451_senpai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{凌|しの}ぐ - to surpass one's senior

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{耐|た}える→耐える：12087_taeru⟧ - to withstand; describes bearing up under strain, with no sense of a stopgap
- ⟦{我慢|がまん}→我慢：00057_gaman⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to put up with; about self-restraint rather than getting through a period
- ⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧, ⟦{上回|うわまわ}る→上回る：07648_uwamawaru⟧ - plain "to exceed" for sense 2; neither carries {凌|しの}ぐ's overtone of overtaking a superior

WRITING:
{凌|しの} is a ⟦{人名用漢字|じんめいようかんじ}→人名用漢字：30112_jinmeiyoukanji⟧ rather than a ⟦{常用漢字|じょうようかんじ}→常用漢字：20778_jouyoukanji⟧, so newspapers and public writing normally spell the verb しのぐ in kana. Both spellings are read the same.

REGISTER:
Neutral to slightly literary. Far more common in writing than in conversation.
